signed_margin: law times half the difference of the native logits across opposite motor orientations

controls.sham: Suppress graph writes on all three intact sensory contacts.
controls.false_sign: Invert each sampled support taste and otherwise permit native writes.
controls.shuffled_objects: Apply one matched random three-cycle to the canonical sign assignments, then encode each donor sign using the current object's actual sampled side. The two all-same assignments are invariant to this permutation.
